name: Floating Wrist Bracelet
description: Hang on to your keys while you have fun in and on the water with these cool and colorful floating bracelet keychains! This 4" x 0.6" foam and PVC bracelet has a polyester exterior and a durable metal ring for a secure grip on your keys. Wear this loose-fitting item around your wrist -- should you drop it into the water, it floats so your keys won't be lost. Choose from three neon-inspired colors and add your organizational or company logo, emblem or message. A great item for use at water parks, pools, the beach, boating and for other water-related sports and activities.
